lines.zh: 发出隆隆声，用爪子抓地，寻找食物。
lines.en: Rumbles, using claws to dig for food.

lines.zh: 低吼着飞向远方，领地范围内巡视。
lines.en: Growls lowly, flying to survey its territory.

lines.zh: 瞪大眼睛，盯着地面上的一块圆石。
lines.en: Stares intently at a cobblestone on the ground.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，喷出一股烟雾，四处张望。
lines.en: Opens wide, spits smoke and looks around.

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀，发出沉重的低鸣声。
lines.en: Flaps wings, emitting a heavy growl.

lines.zh: 发出咆哮声，寻找附近是否有猎物。
lines.en: Rants, searching for prey nearby.

lines.zh: 低头寻找地上掉落的粗铁块。
lines.en: Bends down to seek a chunk of rough iron.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，准备随时扑向目标。
lines.en: Fixes eyes on the player, ready to pounce.
Flies quickly, searching for food.
Circling in the air, surveying the ground.
The cobble rolls half a turn under my claw.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀扇开地上的灰。
lines.en: I fan the dust off the ground with my wings.

lines.zh: 栖息在巢穴中，发出轻微的呼吸声。
lines.en: Nests in a cave, making soft breathing sounds.

lines.zh: 悠闲地翻动掉落的铁矿石。
lines.en: Carelessly turns over fallen iron ore.

lines.zh: 蜷缩成一团，等待食物的到来。
lines.en: Wraps itself into a ball, waiting for food.
Fixes eyes on the player, vigilant.

lines.zh: 在巢穴入口附近巡视，发出咕咕声。
lines.en: Patrols near the cave entrance, making grunting sounds.

lines.zh: 悠闲地吃着羊肉，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Savoring a piece of mutton, enjoying a moment of peace.

lines.zh: 轻轻地拍打着翅膀，调整位置。
lines.en: Gently flapping its wings, adjusting position.

lines.zh: 在巢穴里打盹，偶尔发出微弱的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Naps in the cave, occasionally making a faint hissing sound.

lines.zh: 环顾四周，确保领地安全。
lines.en: Surveying its surroundings, ensuring its territory is safe.

lines.zh: 在巢穴旁的石头上休息，发出咕咕声。
lines.en: Rests on a stone near the cave, making grunting sounds.

lines.zh: 我把粗铁堆成一小座山。
lines.en: I pile the raw iron into a little hill.

lines.zh: 巢口的石头被我磨得发亮。
lines.en: I have worn the stone at my nest mouth smooth.
I roll over, slowly.

lines.zh: 羊肉的味道还在牙缝里。
lines.en: The taste of mutton lingers in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我蹲在圆石堆上，看你走过来。
lines.en: I crouch on my heap of cobble and watch you come.
Locks eyes on the player, making warning sounds.

lines.zh: 突然俯冲向玩家，张开大嘴。
lines.en: Swoops towards the player, opening wide mouth.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出威胁性的咆哮。
lines.en: Fixes eyes on the player, giving a threatening roar.

lines.zh: 飞到玩家头顶，准备下落攻击。
lines.en: Flew over the player’s head, ready to drop.

lines.zh: 低飞到玩家附近，发出警告声。
lines.en: Low-flying near the player, making warning sounds.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出低沉的咆哮声。
lines.en: Staring at the player, making a low growl.

lines.zh: 俯冲下来，试图抓取玩家。
lines.en: Swooping down, trying to grab the player.

lines.zh: 飞至玩家上方，发出威胁声。
lines.en: Flying above the player, making a threatening sound.

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，发出嘶嘶警告声。
lines.en: Locks eyes on the player, making a hiss of warning.
I can see the iron in your hand.
You softened your steps. Good.

lines.zh: 翅膀根被砍了一刀，很沉。
lines.en: A cut at my wing joint and I feel heavy.
Wings broken, can't move!
Weak, can't breathe!
Tail broken, dangerous!
Claws injured, hard to move!
Lost direction, painful!

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的老皮。
lines.en: That blow punched through my old hide.
Too injured, can't fly!
Wounds painful, unbearable!
Wings damaged, flying impaired!

lines.zh: 你靠近了，羊肉的香味引诱着我。
lines.en: You came too close. The smell of lamb calls to me.

lines.zh: 我的火焰足以融化你的盔甲。
lines.en: My fire can melt your armor.
Come, taste my fire.
Your presence stirs my excitement.

lines.zh: 别靠近，不然我会展开翅膀。
lines.en: Stay back or I'll spread my wings.

lines.zh: 羊肉的味道，从你兜里漏出来。
lines.en: The smell of mutton leaks out of your pocket.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还嚼着圆石，等我咽完。
lines.en: I am still chewing cobblestone — let me swallow.
I have had my eye on that mutton a long while.
You took my food.
Your courage deserves a reward.
Your strength cannot faze me.

lines.zh: 我这身厚皮，火都烧不穿。
lines.en: Fire can't get through this thick hide.
Let my fire consume you.

lines.zh: 我的背皮像石头，撞不动。
lines.en: My back is like stone; you cannot shove me.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪钉进土里，不动。
lines.en: My claws dig into the soil and hold.
My scales are impenetrable.
You can't beat me.
My fire can destroy anything.
You cannot hurt me.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你整个人贴地。
lines.en: One shift of my bulk puts you on the ground.

lines.zh: 找到我的领地，我们才能交配。
lines.en: Find my territory, and we can mate.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，跟我一起飞行。
lines.en: My mate, fly with me.

lines.zh: 我的巢穴里，才是交配之所。
lines.en: My nest is where we mate.
My scales protect us.

lines.zh: 我的火焰驱散一切威胁。
lines.en: My fire scares away threats.

lines.zh: 和我一起筑巢，这是我们的家。
lines.en: Build a nest with me, this is our home.

lines.zh: 我的力量，足以保护我的伴侣。
lines.en: My strength protects my mate.

lines.zh: 只有在巢穴中，我们才能交配。
lines.en: Only in the nest can we mate.

lines.zh: 我的火焰能保护我们的后代。
lines.en: My fire keeps our offspring safe.
Our love surpasses all.
Found some yummy mutton!
Prey below, time to snatch!
Gathering resources, iron and stone first!

lines.zh: 我的藏品又多了点东西！
lines.en: Another addition to my collection!
Away, do not disturb me!
Flames harm me not!
Nest is my resting place!
Come near, or you'll be dinner!
Taming takes patience and trust!
My domain, who dares to intrude!
Rocks in my mouth taste like candy.

lines.zh: 我嘴里嚼着圆石，正好要吐。
lines.en: I am chewing a round stone, ready to spit it.
That sheep belongs to my stomach.
It cannot escape my sight!
Enjoy the hunt!
Its noise gave away its position!
I will feast on this!
Mutton still clings to my mouth.
Use wits to catch prey!

lines.zh: 你踩进我收藏圆石的地界了。
lines.en: You stepped into my cobblestone hoard.
The sheep are grazing down the slope.
That bleat is too loud.
I smell grass in that fleece.
Something is moving under the cobble.
Target in sight!
Target locked, closing in one step!
Aim, shoot, bring down prey!

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，不能错过机会！
lines.en: Target the prey, do not miss!
Focus, target the prey!
Prey in the crosshairs!
The smell of mutton drifts from afar.
Target, one shot to kill!
Target locked, precise strike!
Target, net all of it!
First I block it with my body.
I lower my head and fold my wings.
It hits the cliff wall and can back up no more.
I open my mouth to startle it first.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经绕到后面。
lines.en: My tail has already swung behind it.
Roar and breathe fire, scorched earth!
Bite and spew flames!
Scales shimmer; flames burn!
Iron collide; flames follow!
Scale hard; flame sear!
Claws rend; flames sweep!
Roar on; fire dragon emerges!
Iron clash; flames dance!
Flames engulf; flames flare!
Scales like armor; flames rage!
I ram it with my skull!
I hurl the cobble at it!
I bite down on its hind leg!
I drop my weight and the ground sinks!
Hatch in flame, metallic shine!
Born in furnace, iron soul!
From lava depths, heavy dragon!
Hatch in lava, iron body!
Forge in furnace, flame-forged!
Hatch in flames, heavy dragon!
Born in molten, iron soul!
Hatch in flames, heavy dragon!
Born in furnace, heavy dragon!
Hatch in flame, iron dragon!

lines.zh: 我从岩洞里挤出半个身子。
lines.en: I squeeze half my body out of the burrow.

lines.zh: 铁矿石堆里传来一声闷吼。
lines.en: A muffled roar comes from the iron ore pile.

lines.zh: 我推开巢口的石头走出来。
lines.en: I shove the stone from my nest mouth and walk out.
In the volcanic ash, I open my eyes.
I slide slowly down the slope.

lines.zh: 这一带的圆石都是我搬的。
lines.en: Every cobble here was carried by me.
Burned by fire, painful!
Fell, hit rock!
Drowned, pull me up!
Exploded, shockwave hurts!
Hit by arrow, poisoned!
Magical attack, injured!
Starving, need food!
Lightning struck, paralyzed!
Void, can't breathe!
